cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've spilled paint on my sofa. Lovely. I'll fetch a cloth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the carpet too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful coverage. You must be thrilled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you get the blue paint out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. I'll start with the part that used to be my afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've spilled paint on my sofa. Stay there; I'll get a cloth. We can fix this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the carpet too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep blotting. You're doing well. That carpet was my birthday present.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cloth's spreading it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. Good catch. Take my clean shirt. I am absolutely furious, but you are not tackling this alone.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers a cloth, but A3's 'You must be thrilled' replaces encouragement with mockery.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's spreading paint; A5 barely uses B4's request to remove blue paint.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants practical cleanup, while A3 mainly ridicules B rather than helping.

heightening.evidence: A5 complains about the afternoon without developing the helpfulness or visibly increasing fury.

specificity.evidence: A1's painted sofa and B2's carpet establish an immediately playable domestic accident.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Wonderful coverage' is compact; A5's afternoon metaphor displaces the cleanup.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 pairs encouragement with the birthday carpet's loss; A5 supplies a shirt while declaring fury. The anger is more stated than enacted.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 extends the spill to the carpet, which A3 addresses; B4 discredits the cloth, so A5 substitutes a clean shirt.

relationship.evidence: B4 reports that the attempted repair is failing; A5 credits B's observation and maintains practical solidarity despite personal loss.

heightening.evidence: After B4, A5 sacrifices another possession to help, increasing A's commitment while the explicitly expressed anger rises.

specificity.evidence: A1 immediately establishes spilled paint on A's sofa; A3's birthday carpet and A5's clean shirt provide playable personal stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's encouragement beside the birthday-present detail earns the tension; A5's explicit emotional declaration explains some of the joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the carpet as newly damaged; A3 directs blotting and reveals that carpet's sentimental value.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 says the cloth spreads paint; A5 acknowledges the failure and offers a clean shirt instead.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 sustain practical help and encouragement while A's resentment becomes explicit fury.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5's willingness to sacrifice a shirt after the sofa and carpet makes continued support increasingly costly.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A must keep providing sincere help and encouragement as the same interaction makes A increasingly furious.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Sarcastic politeness can sound supportive while actually withdrawing encouragement and care.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 mocks B's satisfaction; revised A3 praises blotting and A5 supplies a shirt despite explicit fury.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised within the paint accident to restore simultaneous support and anger. Second internal pass: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 encourage through fury), logic 5 (B4's spreading cloth causes A5's shirt), relationship 4 (B2/B4 report worsening damage), heightening 4 (A5 sacrifices clothing), specificity 5 (A1 sofa cleanup), brevity 4 (A5 is direct but explicit): 92/100. Five spoken ABABA turns and the word limit pass.
records.remainingConcern: Accepted as supplied; no rewrite needed. The growing fury relies partly on A5 naming it, rather than on consistently escalating verbal strain.
records.writerReservation: A5 names fury directly; performance must also convey its increase without making the encouragement sarcastic.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike the birthday chauffeur in D21-single-b, this A faces damage to personal possessions and offers increasingly costly physical help.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take your time choosing lunch. I'm delighted to drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might look at another menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. The parking meter loves exploring too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we go somewhere else?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll tell the meter it was only a relationship trial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 prompts parking pressure in A3, but A5's 'relationship trial' adds little to B4's relocation request.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 express indecision; A's actual support remains largely the initial driving offer.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the meter joke without increasing sacrifice or anger after B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes lunch and driving; A3 supplies a credible parking constraint.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'relationship trial' feels constructed around the meter rather than A's sincere objective.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 combines 'Forty pounds wasted' with encouragement; A5 escalates to 'bloody sandwich' while arranging the booking and affirming B deserves a window.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 identifies the lost deposit, which A3 resents but accepts; B4 adds another forty, directly producing A5's eighty-pound calculation and request for the number.

relationship.evidence: A1 gives B birthday choice; B2 chooses the sea and B4 commits by booking, increasing the cost of A's sincere support.

heightening.evidence: B4's additional payment makes A5 angrier and more actively helpful: A takes over the call while insisting on B's sea view.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes birthday lunch and driving; B2 and A3 locate the conflict in a seaside preference and an existing forty-pound deposit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich' earns its irritation from B4's payment request; the window encouragement sustains the contradiction.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's seaside choice and forfeited deposit become A3's simultaneous resentment and encouragement to make a day of it.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 doubles the immediate outlay, causing A5's cost calculation, stronger language and offer to handle the booking.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 preserve helpfulness while anger rises from 'Fine' to 'bloody sandwich.'
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 spends more effort securing B's birthday pleasure precisely when B4 makes that pleasure more infuriating.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A continues helping and encouraging B while successive costs make A's speech increasingly furious.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Passive aggression would make the encouragement a disguised attack on B instead of sustaining the promised treat.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 endorses B2's seaside choice despite the lost deposit; A5 protests the doubled cost yet actively secures B4's booking and encourages a window request.

Separate internal reread: fidelity 4 (A3's restrained complaint grows into A5's angry arithmetic while help continues), logic 5 (B2 loses the deposit; B4 doubles the outlay), relationship 4 (B chooses and books the desired treat), heightening 4 (A5 funds the new commitment while pushing for a better seat), specificity 5 (A1 birthday drive, B2 seaside reservation), brevity 4 (A5's sandwich complaint arises from the actual expense): 86/100. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and hard gates pass; this is model review only.
records.remainingConcern: A5 contains several supportive tags; the anger depends partly on delivery, though the language establishes a clear increase. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A3's 'Fine' and A5's window encouragement must remain sincere; the text gives anger a concrete cause but delivery still controls whether support sounds barbed.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One lift and you praise my garden publicly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just pay you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we're negotiating the value of friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One lift, then. And tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just pay you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds. Three if you say we're still friends when you hand it over.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices a favor and A3 renegotiates it, but A5 labels negotiation instead of making another proposal.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's five minutes causes A3's lower price; B4's cash offer gets only an abstract response.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges disproportionate terms and B4 offers a simpler transaction.

heightening.evidence: A5 invokes friendship without attaching a new condition or consequence to B4's payment offer.

specificity.evidence: A1's ladder and station lifts establish concrete neighborly bargaining.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's public garden praise is economical and characterful; A5 is more explanatory.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices a ladder loan in lifts; A3 trades for praise; A5 assigns a cash discount to an affirmation of friendship.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's five-minute limit reduces A3's transport demand; B4's cash proposal becomes A5's priced offer with a relational discount.

relationship.evidence: B4 seeks a simpler transaction, while A5 reveals a desire to preserve friendship within that transaction.

heightening.evidence: A5 responds to B4's attempt to depersonalize the exchange by making friendship itself part of the price.

specificity.evidence: A1's ladder and station lifts establish a recognizable neighborly exchange; A3's roses and A5's prices make the bargaining concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Three if you say we're still friends' economically exposes A's emotional bargaining; A3's roses are slightly ornamental.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 minimizes the loan's duration; A3 lowers two lifts to one and adds a noncash term.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks to pay; A5 supplies a cash price and discounts it for spoken reassurance.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A negotiates practical favors, social praise and friendship across A1, A3 and A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns B's proposed escape into a cash transaction that still requires negotiating a feeling.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A turns practical favors and emotional reassurance alike into terms that can be offered and exchanged.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary haggling concerns the ladder's price alone rather than treating friendship itself as negotiable consideration.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 and A3 bargain over use; revised A5 gives a cash discount specifically for reassurance about friendship.

records.recommendedEdit: Preserved the neighborly ladder setting and replaced A5's commentary with an actual counteroffer. Second internal pass: fidelity 5 (A5 prices reassurance), logic 5 (B4 cash becomes A5 cash terms), relationship 4 (B seeks a simpler payment), heightening 4 (friendship enters the bargain), specificity 5 (A1 ladder/lifts), brevity 4 (A5 compact conditional offer): 92/100. ABABA and word limit pass.
records.remainingConcern: Accepted as supplied; no rewrite needed. A3's request for praise about roses adds a small incidental detour.
records.writerReservation: The monetary figures are illustrative, and the affectionate discount should sound sincerely important to A.
records.alternativeComparison: D22-single-a bargains for favors and reassurance between neighbors; D22-single-b negotiates restitution and forgiveness after damage.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology, subject to the following terms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just be sorry?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For how long? I need a warranty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I mean it sincerely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put 'sincere' beside the refund clause.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 conditions acceptance and A3 demands a warranty, clearly commercializing the apology.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's sorrow, but A5 introduces a refund clause without any established loss or payment.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 seek recognition of remorse, but the unknown offense limits their practical options.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds contractual language to B4's sincerity without making its consequences clear.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an apology but never identifies the incident, relationship, or desired remedy.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'I need a warranty' is concise and follows the transactional attitude.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices acceptance of an apology in Christmas access; A3 bargains over reported hurt; A5 makes genuine forgiveness conditional on a longer visit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's Christmas Day commitment makes A3 request Boxing Day. B4 demands actual emotional change, so A5 offers to mean the forgiveness for an increased price.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects an existing commitment to Mum, while B4 seeks sincere reconciliation. Both constrain A's bargaining within a recognizable family relationship.

heightening.evidence: After B4 rejects merely reported forgiveness, A5 raises the visit requirement through New Year and includes stopping complaints to Mum.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a missed birthday and competing holiday arrangements immediately; B2 and A3 make the family calendar concrete with Christmas Day and Boxing Day.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Stay through New Year and I'll mean it' compactly turns B4's emotional request into a higher-priced concession; the additional Mum clause slightly extends the beat.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reserves Christmas Day for Mum; A3 shifts the requested visit to Boxing Day and offers a concession involving Mum.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 distinguishes actual forgiveness from telling Mum about it; A5 explicitly offers to 'mean it' in return for staying longer.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: D22 explains why A1, A3 and A5 turn apology, family access and emotional resolution into exchangeable terms.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 increases the price from a holiday date to a stay through New Year while bringing genuine forgiveness into the same negotiation.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A negotiates acceptance of an apology, reported hurt and genuine forgiveness as concessions purchased with family time.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary reconciliation can involve spending time together; A explicitly prices both the announcement and the sincerity of emotional recovery.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 offers B2's available holiday a declaration to Mum; B4's request for genuine recovery makes A5 charge a longer visit and add silence about the grievance.

records.recommendedEdit: Corrected only the rejected candidate's A5, preserving its illustrative missed-birthday and holiday setting. Removed the ambiguous choice of forgiveness timing: the longer stay now purchases genuine recovery and an additional promise to stop mentioning the grievance. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 prices reported recovery and A5 actual recovery), logic 5 (B2 changes the date; B4's 'actually' causes A5's 'mean it'), relationship 4 (B2 has a family commitment and B4 seeks sincere reconciliation), heightening 4 (A5 raises the requested visit length and adds a concession), specificity 4 (A1 birthday and Christmas; B2 Mum), brevity 4 (A5 keeps both concessions tied to the same birthday): 90/100. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all hard gates pass. Original firstPass is preserved exactly; this is model review only.
records.remainingConcern: A5's promise to change a feeling requires sincere transactional confidence in performance. The final Mum concession is slightly redundant. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's confidence that a longer visit will change a feeling remains deliberately unreasonable. The offer must be sincere, and B remains free to reject the increased price.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved ladder alternative negotiates a practical favor and reassurance about friendship. This alternative negotiates family time and the authenticity of forgiveness, with B resisting emotional substitution rather than proposing cash.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help you move. I've brought moral support.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need someone to carry the sofa.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I'll encourage that person enthusiastically.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to bring muscle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My jaw's a muscle. You're doing wonderfully.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help you move the sofa. I'll take the cushions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. We have to lift together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You lift; I'll say when. Together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need another person underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll book someone on your phone. Then I can give both of you the same countdown.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 agrees to help but supplies moral support; A3 and A5 keep redefining the promise to avoid carrying.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's sofa prompts A3's encouragement of its carrier; B4's 'muscle' directly supplies A5's jaw reinterpretation.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs physical help and B4 invokes A's prior promise, tightening the obligation.

heightening.evidence: A5 absorbs B4's explicit muscle requirement into the same self-serving form of assistance.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes moving help and B2 identifies the sofa that needs carrying.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's jaw claim is brief and earned by B4's wording, though deliberately cheeky.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 agrees to help but selects cushions; A3 redefines 'together' as giving instructions, and A5 agrees to another lifter while remaining the countdown caller.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's sewn-on cushions defeat A1's light task and cause A3's supervisory interpretation; B4's need for another person produces A5's hired replacement.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 insist on the physical help needed to move the sofa, successively closing A's escape routes.

heightening.evidence: After B4 demands a second person underneath, A5 expands the labor force using B's phone and promotes A's own role to directing both lifters.

specificity.evidence: A1's sofa and cushions establish the task instantly; B2's sewn-on detail makes the first attempted evasion physically concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'You lift; I'll say when. Together' compresses the reinterpretation; A5's shared countdown extends that exact logic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 rules out carrying separate cushions and requests joint lifting; A3 converts joint lifting into coordinated lifting under A's direction.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 specifies another body underneath the sofa; A5 proposes obtaining that body without providing A's own.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each A turn explicitly agrees and then allocates the physical burden elsewhere.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns the demand that A join the work into an opportunity for A to supervise two workers.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A agrees to each concrete requirement while redefining participation so A keeps the effortless supervisory role.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simple refusal would decline lifting; A instead claims each favorable substitute fulfills B's requested cooperation.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 accepts B2's 'together' as synchronized instruction, and A5 accepts B4's extra lifter by booking someone else through B's phone.

records.recommendedEdit: Replaced the jaw pun with successive practical attempts to exempt A from lifting. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5 (A1, A3 and A5 agree while assigning A the easiest role), logic 5 (B2 blocks detachable cushions; B4 requires an actual second lifter), relationship 4 (B repeatedly specifies the help needed), heightening 4 (A5 adds outside labor while preserving command), specificity 5 (A1 sofa, B2 sewn cushions), brevity 4 (A3's 'Together' expresses the reinterpretation economically): 92/100. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and hard gates pass. Original firstPass remains unchanged despite the supplied later rejection.
records.remainingConcern: Booking a lifter may take time, but A5 is a playable proposal that B can resist. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: Using B's phone implies that B will manage the booking expense; the scene does not establish payment, so the primary benefit to A is avoiding physical work.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll look after your dog for the weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is the dog here at my office?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm looking after him from behind. Excellent visibility.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant at your house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you should have specified a viewing location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs to stay overnight too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Stay in my guest room; you can handle breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can stay, but his six o'clock walk is your job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll organise it: lead by the door, your alarm at five thirty. You won't have to plan a thing.

heightening.evidence: A5's complaint about specifications does not develop a new favorable interpretation of B4.

specificity.evidence: A1's weekend dog care and B2's office are concrete, though A3's position is awkward to play.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'from behind' and A5's 'viewing location' prioritize wordplay over the agreement.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 agrees to overnight care but assigns breakfast to B; A5 agrees the walk is A's job, then redefines that job as organizing B's labor. A1's favorable reinterpretation is milder.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs overnight accommodation during repairs; B4 accepts staying but explicitly protects a division of labor, giving A a concrete boundary to reinterpret.

heightening.evidence: A3 preserves A's sleep by assigning breakfast to B; after B4's explicit boundary, A5 claims responsibility while scheduling B to perform the early walk.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'You won't have to plan a thing' presents transferred labor as a benefit, earning its joke from B4's attempt to make A do the walk.

hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 accepts the accommodation but assigns A the six o'clock walk. A5 claims organizational ownership and sets B's alarm to perform it.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: D23 supplies the repeated agreement followed by self-serving reinterpretation: overnight hosting replaces caregiving in A3, and planning replaces walking in A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 applies the established evasion to an explicitly assigned duty, turning B's attempted safeguard into a plan serving A's sleep.

Separate internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 agree while protecting A's sleep), logic 5 (B2 causes the lodging arrangement; B4's assigned walk causes A5's preparation tactic), relationship 4 (B4 accepts accommodation but sets a concrete boundary), heightening 4 (A5 converts even explicitly assigned work into B's earlier start), specificity 5 (A1 kitchen repairs, A3 guest room, B4 six o'clock walk), brevity 4 (A5's planning assurance makes the self-serving agreement playable): 92/100. cards.title: The Pattern

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.
